assessment: The sample misses both handling-time and course-set targets. Assignment changes and renames are associated with affected exports, but neither the selection mechanism nor the cause of handling time is established. One opening is warranted; feasibility within six engineer-days remains unverified.

openings.claim: Hypothesis: presenting a requested week through current assignments and names generates reconciliation demand. If replacements repeat that resolution against a moving present, export discrepancies can cause retries that create further discrepancies. Replace this dependency with a center-specific, week-specific course manifest confirmed once and reused for replacements.
openings.delta: Counterfactual branch: forbid current instructor assignment as the authority for historical course membership. Change the export interface to accept stable course identities plus week-specific display labels, showing unresolved membership before generation. The former dependency's obligations are course inclusion, instructor relevance to the week, understandable labels, and center ownership. The manifest and confirmation must discharge each explicitly. This hybrid combines an explicit course-set contract with the existing CSV generator; their interaction holds membership steady while attendance values can refresh under a stated cutoff.
openings.prediction: With the same intended timetable, changing only current assignment or course name should leave manifest-based membership unchanged. Fewer repeated membership discrepancies would support the feedback hypothesis; unchanged discrepancies would weaken it. Any confirmation effort must count toward handling time.
openings.probe: Use the six coordinators' two sessions for counterbalanced fabricated baseline and manifest exports, covering reassignment, rename, split courses, and another center. Record total handling and component times, intended membership, and replacement requests. Verify documented CSV import and concurrent attendance entry. If feasible within the cap, evaluate the next 40 exports against all stated targets.
assumptions: Replacement dependencies: tenant-scoped stable course identities; persisted weekly manifests; authorized coordinator confirmation; sufficiently reliable weekly schedule evidence; explicit instructor and label information where needed; existing CSV serialization; nonblocking attendance reads and an explicit cutoff.
All participant processing stays in the private service and authorized workspace. Existing capabilities must support the change within six engineer-days and the hosting allowance; this is unverified.
